vectors.name: ser-01-key-ordering
vectors.exercises: object key ordering (UTF-16 code-unit) + array element order preserved

vectors.name: ser-02-unicode-nfc
vectors.exercises: Unicode NFC normalization of keys and values: DECOMPOSED input (base char + combining mark) must serialize to the PRECOMPOSED form

vectors.name: ser-03-decimal-scaling
vectors.exercises: all numeric values carried as strings (no JSON number tokens); scaled fixed-point integers and negative/zero cases

vectors.name: ser-04-control-and-escapes
vectors.exercises: minimal string escaping: quote, backslash, control chars

vectors.name: ser-05-nested-mixed
vectors.exercises: nested objects/arrays, booleans, null, empty object/array
